intro.label: Opportunities
intro.title: Selected opportunities.
intro.lead: Opportunities reach us through founders, operators, investors and local partners. We share them selectively, with qualified investors and strategic partners, under NDA.
intro.notice: Illustrative examples. The opportunities shown describe the types of mandates we work on. They are not offers and contain no client information. Live opportunities are shared privately with qualified parties.

items.summary: A regional digital infrastructure platform seeking a strategic investor to fund expansion across Saudi Arabia.

sections.overview: An established operator of digital infrastructure services for enterprise and public-sector customers, looking for a strategic investor to accelerate its expansion programme.
sections.market: Enterprise and government digitisation in Saudi Arabia is driving sustained demand for local capacity, connectivity and managed services, with a preference for in-country providers.
sections.business: Recurring, contract-based revenue from enterprise customers, an experienced local management team and an expansion pipeline that requires growth capital.
sections.thesis: Structural demand growth, high switching costs and the value of local presence support long-term, contracted cash flows.
sections.opportunity: A minority or significant minority position alongside the founders, with governance rights and participation in the expansion plan.
sections.rationale: Attractive for investors seeking infrastructure-like exposure to the Saudi digital economy, or for strategic investors adding regional capability.
sections.structure: Primary investment into the operating company or a dedicated expansion vehicle, structured with qualified legal and tax counsel.
sections.next: Qualified investors receive a teaser under NDA, followed by management access and a data room.

items.summary: A proven hospitality software product seeking a GCC partner to launch a regional joint venture.

sections.overview: An international hospitality technology company with a proven product, seeking a regional partner to establish a joint venture for the GCC.
sections.market: New hotel and destination supply across the Gulf is creating demand for modern guest-experience, operations and revenue-management technology.
sections.business: A software platform with an established international customer base, adaptable to Arabic-language and regional operating requirements.
sections.thesis: Pairing a proven product with local relationships shortens sales cycles and builds a defensible regional position.
sections.opportunity: A joint venture combining the technology licence with a partner bringing capital, hospitality relationships and local operations.
sections.rationale: Suits hospitality groups, real estate developers and investors with exposure to the regional tourism pipeline.
sections.structure: A GCC joint-venture company with a technology licence, shared governance and agreed contribution of capital and distribution.
sections.next: Introductory discussion, partner fit assessment and a jointly developed business plan.

items.summary: An applied-AI company serving enterprises in Central Asia, raising growth capital for regional expansion.

sections.overview: A technology company delivering applied-AI products for enterprises in Uzbekistan, with plans to expand across Central Asia and into the GCC.
sections.market: Rapid digitisation of the Uzbek economy and limited local AI capability create room for a focused regional player.
sections.business: Products for document processing, customer service and analytics, sold to enterprise and institutional customers.
sections.thesis: A local team with enterprise references, cost-efficient delivery and a credible path to regional expansion.
sections.opportunity: A growth round to fund product development, sales capacity and entry into neighbouring markets.
sections.rationale: Exposure to Central Asian technology growth with a business that can also serve GCC customers.
sections.structure: Equity investment, potentially through a holding structure, coordinated with qualified counsel.
sections.next: Teaser and management presentation under NDA, followed by commercial and technical due diligence.

items.summary: A sports technology concept looking for a strategic partner to launch in Saudi Arabia.

sections.overview: A sports technology concept serving fans, clubs and venues, prepared for launch in Saudi Arabia with a strategic partner.
sections.market: Investment in sport, events and venues across the Kingdom is creating demand for fan engagement, ticketing and performance technology.
sections.business: A digital platform combining fan engagement and commercial tools for rights holders and venues.
sections.thesis: A strategic partner with sports relationships can unlock distribution and early anchor customers.
sections.opportunity: A strategic partnership or joint venture to launch, localise and commercialise the platform.
sections.rationale: Relevant to sports organisations, media groups and investors building exposure to the sports economy.
sections.structure: Partnership agreement or JV company with defined contributions, governance and economics.
sections.next: Partner discussion, concept review and joint launch plan.

items.summary: Modernising an established industrial business in Uzbekistan through a JV with a technology partner.

sections.overview: An established industrial group in Uzbekistan seeking a technology partner to digitise operations and create a jointly owned solutions business.
sections.market: Industrial modernisation is a national priority, and many producers are still running on manual or legacy processes.
sections.business: An operating industrial business with stable revenue, a modernisation budget and access to sector peers.
sections.thesis: Digitising a lighthouse operation creates a reference case that a JV can then sell across the sector.
sections.opportunity: A joint venture between the industrial group and a European or GCC technology partner.
sections.rationale: Suits industrial technology companies looking for a Central Asian entry point with an anchor customer.
sections.structure: A JV company with technology licensing, implementation services and shared economics.
sections.next: Site assessment, partner matching and a joint business plan.
